parts.text: A student investigates the period of a pendulum. Fig. 1.1 shows the set-up.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The distance d is measured from the bottom of the clamp to the centre of the bob. The student adjusts the length of the pendulum until d = 50.0 cm. He displaces the bob slightly and releases it so that it swings. He uses a stop-watch to measure the time t for 10 complete oscillations.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Fig. 1.2 shows the reading on the stop-watch. Record, in Table 1.1, the time t for 10 complete oscillations. [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate and record in Table 1.1, the period T of the pendulum. The period is the time for one complete oscillation. [1]

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Calculate T 2 and record your value in Table 1.1. [1]

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Write the units in the column headings. [2] Table 1.1 d / t / T / T 2 / 50.0 100.0 20.20 2.02 4.08
